title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
title_zh: CineEvolve：面向电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体式自进化框架

paragraphs.en: 提出CineEvolve智能体式自进化框架，通过导演与评论家交替强化学习实现电影级多镜头视频生成。 Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.
paragraphs.zh: 提出CineEvolve智能体式自进化框架，通过导演与评论家交替强化学习实现电影级多镜头视频生成。电影级多镜头视频生成既需要叙事规划，也需要迭代式打磨。 现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理能力，要么依赖不进行策略更新的前馈式工作流程。 在本文中，我们提出CineEvolve，这是一个面向电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体式自进化框架，它将导演与评论家统一在同一个视觉-语言策略之中。 为了模拟现实世界中将迭代执导与批判性反馈相结合的电影制作过程，我们通过交替强化学习训练CineEvolve：导演暴露缺陷以锤炼评论家，而更新后的评论家则指导导演进行针对性的修订。 为稳定共同进化过程，我们引入了进化GRPO（E-GRPO），利用历史锚定与修订保护机制来缓解优势膨胀问题。 此外，我们贡献了CineTraj，一个涵盖创作、评论与修订环节的40K电影轨迹数据集。 大量实验表明，CineEvolve优于现有方法。 我们的代码将发布于 https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve。
